instruction.text: Build the name of the country.

hint.text: The official name of this country is the Kingdom of the Netherlands.
hint.label: Official name

instruction.text: What do you know about the Netherlands? Complete the fact file.
Which continent is the Netherlands in?
What does the flag of the Netherlands look like?
Which currency belongs to the Netherlands?
Read the text and select the matching image.

atoms.a: There are many windmills in the Netherlands. In the past, they used to pump out water to prevent the low lands from flooding.
atoms.sound: There are many windmills in the Netherlands. In the past, they used to pump out water to prevent the low lands from flooding.

atoms.a: The Netherlands are known worldwide for their traditional wooden shoes, which are called clogs.
atoms.sound: The Netherlands are known worldwide for their traditional wooden shoes, which are called clogs.

atoms.a: A famous treat from the Netherlands is the stroopwafel, which is two thin waffles with sweet syrup in between.
atoms.sound: A famous treat from the Netherlands is the strowpvofl, which is two thin waffles with sweet syrup in between.

atoms.a: The Netherlands are famous for their colourful tulips. In the spring, entire fields are covered with the flowers.
